status.en: 10 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Aleppo.
status.nb: 10 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Aleppo.

summary.en: ISIL carried out a suicide bombing in Hasakah that killed two Syrian internal security members and injured five others. The same attack was described as a motorcycle bomb in northeast Syria, targeting a security post. CENTCOM praised Syrian authorities for disrupting a drug and weapons smuggling network. The conflict continues with frequent attacks on security forces in the northeast. 2,732 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: ISIL gjennomførte et selvmordsbombeangrep i Hasakah som drepte to syriske interne sikkerhetsmedlemmer og såret fem andre. Det samme angrepet ble beskrevet som en motorsykkelbombe i nordøst-Syria, rettet mot en sikkerhetspost. CENTCOM roste syriske myndigheter for å ha avbrutt et narkotika‑ og våpensmuglingsnettverk. Konflikten fortsetter med hyppige angrep på sikkerhetsstyrker i nordøst. 2 732 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
